title: Identity and composition for normalized ring refinement maps
statement: For normalized construction data R,F,M,N, the left refinement isomorphisms at finite and completed integral ring stages satisfy identity and composition. Only RingStage is quantified here: rational and closed refinements and all coefficient-change laws are excluded. All categories, geometric hypotheses and normalizations are those of [lem-sf-constructible-exceptional-coefficient-construction]. The actual records and generic action predicates are defined in [def-sf-constructible-exceptional-coefficient-construction-data].

source.place: The construction paragraph of the constructible exceptional adjunction blueprint; this is the normalized coefficient construction split from the assembly theorem.

proof.text: At exponent n+1 choose a bounded constructible etale-origin witness for each finite-Tor input by finiteRing_constructibleDerived_origin. Finite homology support supplies a common cohomological interval, including the zero object. Apply the single-arrow finite ring coordinate identity. Conjugate the existing witnessed intrinsicCompactificationCoherence identity and composition equations by R.left followed by finiteImageIso. Cancel endpoint isomorphisms and use faithfulness of the full finite-Tor inclusion. The resulting laws are for the supplied N.refinement maps themselves.

Apply integral_normalized_ring_refinement_laws at each fixed E. Finally case-split RingStage: every positive finite exponent is n+1 and the other case is integral. The original identity and composition statement follows from the two cases, with no change to hypotheses.

proof_origin.place: H7 reduction: finite single-arrow coordinate transport of the existing coherence theorem; integral fixed-stage theorem; explicit RingStage case split.

theorem normalized_ring_refinement_laws (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{max u v}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{max u v}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (R : CoefficientConstructionRing.{u, v} l Ω D hl (f := f))
    (F : CoefficientConstructionFields.{u, v} l Ω D hl R)
    (M : CoefficientConstructionCommon.{u, v} l Ω D hl R F)
    (N : CoefficientConstructionRefinements.{u, v} l Ω D hl R F M) :
    (∀ (c : Compactification f) (s : RingStage.{max u v} l),
      (N.refinement (.id c) (s.stage l)).left = Iso.refl _) ∧
    (∀ {a b c : Compactification f} (r : a.Refinement b) (t : b.Refinement c)
      (s : RingStage.{max u v} l),
      (N.refinement (r.comp t) (s.stage l)).left =
        (N.refinement r (s.stage l)).left ≪≫ (N.refinement t (s.stage l)).left)
